about_the_game:
Welcome To Glenn State!

After over a year of intense study sessions and sleepless all-nighters, you’ve finally clawed your way out of the GPA pit you dug for yourself and transferred out of Glenn State’s backwater Kurtington campus. Now, in your final semester of college, you’ve made it to the university’s main campus: Glenn State College Valley, where the booze flows freely and the parties never stop (allegedly).

But it’s not that simple. With a graduation requirement of at least 3.00, you’re not exactly sitting pretty with a GPA of only 2.80.

Will you focus on your studies and secure your future?

Will you dive into the wild social scene and risk it all for the college experience you’ve been missing?

Or will you rise above the chaos and begin your epic comeback by graduating while winning the heart of someone truly special?

Key Features

  • Branching romance paths shaped by your choices

  • GPA management system where you must balance between your studies and social life

  • Three romanceable characters, each with unique personalities, struggles, and arcs

  • Multiple endings determined by your grades and relationships

  • A unique college setting that highlights the challenges and humor of modern university life

  • An authentic focus on international student and third culture experiences

Student Profiles

Age: 21

Year: Senior

Major: Management

Nationality: Republic of Francien

Mandarin Name: 梅琳

Marie's upbringing was anything but ordinary.
Born in Villeclaire, Republic of Francien, she moved with her family to Shanghe City, People’s Republic of Dong Yuan, at the age of five due to her father’s career relocation.
This decision, driven by her father’s expansion of his consulting business in Asia, completely altered the course of her life.

From then on, her world was defined by exclusivity and privilege—
living in a high-rise apartment in the city center with a swimming pool and climate-controlled gym,
dining at Shanghe’s top fine-dining restaurants, and wearing designer clothes handpicked by personal stylists.
She attended the most expensive international school in Shanghe, spending summer breaks in top-tier private tutoring sessions and college prep camps.
Even her Chinese name, “Mei Lin,” was no casual choice—
it was meticulously crafted by her father to reflect phonetic harmony, meaningful connotations, and a sense of cultural fusion between France and China.

Fluent in French, Mandarin, and English, she carries herself with a kind of textbook elegance.
To others, she has always been that “perfect girl”—impeccable background, striking looks, and polished manners.

With such a head start and advantages,
one might expect her to enroll in a prestigious international university and glide effortlessly along an elite path.
Yet in reality, she chose Glenn State University—a moderately ranked public institution with little renown.
Still, this never became a burden to her.
After all, when it comes to career advancement, connections are everything—
and she had long secured her place in her father’s company.

She chose to major in management—
a respectable, safe, and faultless choice,
as if following a prewritten script for a “future successor.”

Given her background and poise, blending into the campus elite—whether in sororities or fraternities—
should come naturally.
Right?

Age: 21

Year: Senior

Major: RPTM (Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management)

Nationality: People's Republic of Dong Yuan

Mandarin Name: 惠莹

Hui Ying, from Chendu City, Sanchuan Province, is always the life of the party.
She's the type who makes you think, "This girl is different," from the very first glance—dressed in cute, stylish clothes, yet her words always carry a sarcastic twist.
She's had a quirky and unpredictable personality since childhood, a master at turning "boring" into "fun."
She dislikes rules and rejects conventional scripts. For her, life needs to come with a side of "entertainment."

At Glenn State University, she chose Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management as her major—
for the simplest reason: it seemed easy.
While others choose majors for their career prospects, she picked this one because it "sounded undemanding."
If you ask her what she actually studies, she can't even answer clearly herself: "Uh... Recreation? Tourism? And something Management, was it?"

Her daily motto can be summed up in one phrase:
"Dive in first, ask questions later."
You can often find her sprawled out in a corner of the student center,
lounging in a decidedly lazy posture, wearing pink sunglasses and sipping an iced tea, never failing to quip, "A sunny day like this is just too perfect for attending class."
While she may come off as careless and indifferent about everything,
perhaps only she truly knows—
behind all those casual "whatever"s and easy smiles,
how much still lies buried beneath.

Age: 22

Year: Senior

Major: Finance + Economics Minor

Nationality: People's Republic of Dong Yuan

Mandarin Name: 张星婷

Zhang Xing Ting comes from Jiangzhou City, Zhehe Province—a classic river-town of Dong Yuan.
As an only child, she grew up helping her parents with household duties, often keeping accounts with her accountant father, abacus in hand.
Perhaps from that time on, her life’s direction was already being written into those ledger sheets long ago.

When she came to Glenn State University, she chose Finance and Accounting without hesitation.
She is widely known as a top student and the very definition of "dependable":
she consistently ranks near the top of her class and currently serves as the HR Director of the Dong Yuan Students and Scholars Association (DSSA).
New students often refer to her in private as "our most reassuring Senior Xing Ting."

But her life really does feel like one of clockwork efficiency—
her schedule perpetually packed with classes, student council work, autumn recruitment prep…
While others chat about parties, she’s fine-tuning the color scheme of a budget spreadsheet.
She always says she "prefers to spend time on what matters."

But now, the final semester of her senior year has quietly arrived.
And she’s begun asking herself a question she never before dared to voice:

“If I slow down… will the world wait for me, just this once?”

Frequent strong language and profanity.

Depictions of alcohol consumption and party culture.

Sexual innuendo and suggestive dialogue.

Romantic and flirtatious interactions, including occasional unwelcome advances.
